bio_en: Dr. Hao-Yu Wu is an attending gastroenterologist at the National Taiwan University Cancer Center. He trained in internal medicine and gastroenterology & hepatology at National Taiwan University Hospital and specialises in the endoscopic management of gastrointestinal neoplasms, including endoscopic mucosal resection (EMR) and endoscopic submucosal dissection (ESD).

He is pursuing a PhD in Precision Health and Intelligent Medicine at the NTU School of Advanced Technology. His research brings large language models and deep learning into everyday endoscopy practice — structuring colonoscopy and pathology reports to set surveillance intervals, predicting the risk of laterally spreading tumors from endoscopic images, and measuring the carbon footprint of endoscopy.
bio_zh: 吳浩宇醫師畢業於臺大醫學系，於臺大醫院完成內科及胃腸肝膽科完整訓練，現任臺大癌醫中心分院胃腸肝膽科主治醫師，並於臺大重點科技學院攻讀精準健康博士學程。臨床專精消化道腫瘤診治，擅長內視鏡黏膜切除術（EMR）與黏膜下剝離術（ESD）。
研究核心為大型語言模型與深度學習在臨床的應用：以 LLM 結構化大腸鏡與病理報告以優化追蹤間隔、以內視鏡影像預測側向擴散性腫瘤風險，以及內視鏡的碳足跡與永續醫療。
collaborate_en: I welcome collaboration with clinicians, data scientists and engineers — especially multicentre validation of LLM tools for endoscopy reports, image datasets for colorectal lesions, and sustainable endoscopy. If we met at a conference, I would be glad to continue the conversation.
collaborate_zh: 歡迎臨床、資料科學與工程背景的夥伴合作，特別是內視鏡報告 LLM 工具的多中心驗證、大腸病灶影像資料集與永續內視鏡。如果我們在研討會上見過面，很樂意繼續交流。

themes.text_en: Locally deployable language models that read colonoscopy and pathology reports and recommend guideline-concordant surveillance intervals.

themes.title_zh: AI 內視鏡與 LST 風險
themes.text_en: Multicentre image models that predict malignancy and submucosal invasion in laterally spreading tumors, and metachronous risk after en bloc resection.
themes.text_zh: 多中心影像模型預測側向擴散性腫瘤之惡性與黏膜下侵犯，以及整塊切除後的異時性風險。

themes.text_en: Computer-assisted colonoscopy, adenoma detection and metabolic risk factors for advanced neoplasia.
themes.text_zh: 電腦輔助大腸鏡、腺瘤偵測率與代謝風險因子。

themes.text_en: Quantifying how practice changes such as universal cold snare polypectomy reduce the carbon footprint of colonoscopy.
themes.text_zh: 量化全面採用冷圈套切除等做法對大腸鏡碳足跡的影響。

themes.text_en: A retrieval-augmented chatbot for bowel-preparation education with stool-image recognition, under prospective feasibility testing.
